collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART VIII (141-160, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager has just stacked the perfect woodpile, and a friend pulls a piece out of the middle.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has just finished stacking the firewood. It's perfect. Every piece is the right way round, the big ones are at the bottom, and the whole stack is as neat as a wall. (subject) steps back to admire it. Then (friend) comes along and, without looking, pulls a piece out of the middle.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The stack wobbles. (subject) freezes. (friend) freezes, piece of wood in hand, finally realizing what (friend.he/she) has done. The stack wobbles again, and then settles. Both of them let out a long breath. "...Take one from the top next time," says (subject). "Yes," says (friend). "Yes. Definitely."

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "From the TOP," says (subject), pointing. (friend) looks at the piece in (friend.his/her) hand, then at the hole in the middle of the perfect stack. "Sorry." (friend.He/She) carefully tries to slide it back in. It doesn't fit. (subject) sighs, takes it, and fixes it (subject.him/her)self. It is still, (subject) decides, a very good stack.
